blocks.en:
Table S13 lists how the executor evaluates each operator. A count is evaluated in one of two
ways. If its set is a detect of a class c c , an in_region of such a set within a region R R , or a filter or near of one of these two, the VLM counts c c in a window by Algorithm 1 . The window is the
whole image, the bounding box of R R , or a square of side 2 ​ ρ 2\rho at the anchor, cut to the box of R R if there is
one. The square is centred on the anchor for near and for the direction CENTER , and otherwise its
centre lies ρ \rho away from the centre of the anchor in direction d d . A window other than the whole image is
enlarged by 15% of its size on each side if no side exceeds the cell size, 7,000 pixels for MME-RealWorld and
2,000 for XLRS-Bench overall counting. A larger window, the whole image included, is cut into equal cells of at most
that size, which are counted separately and summed. For RC the
window is the bounding box of the drawn circle enlarged by 15%, counted in one view at 1 M pixels with a question
about the objects inside the red circle. Any other set is grounded, and the count is the number of its boxes
(Section S3.3 ).

blocks.en:
Counting prompt of the synthesiser You translate a multiple-choice question about a large remote-sensing image into a STRICT
  JSON program (no markdown, no commentary, no <think>). You see only the question text,
  never the image and never the answer options. Output exactly one JSON object:
{"answer_type": "count" | "direction", "program": <top>}

<top> is one of:
- {"op": "count", "child": <set>}   how many objects are in <set>
- {"op": "direction", "target": <set>, "reference": <set>}   where <target> is located
  relative to <reference>

<set> (a scored set of detected objects) is one of:
- {"op": "detect", "cls": "<noun phrase>"}   all objects matching the phrase
- {"op": "in_region", "child": <set>, "region": <region>}   objects whose centre lies
  inside the region
- {"op": "filter", "child": <set>, "pred": "<DIR>", "anchor": <set>} objects lying in
  direction DIR of the anchor object
- {"op": "near", "child": <set>, "anchor": <set>}   objects close to the anchor object
- {"op": "argmax", "child": <set>, "key": "<KEY>"} / {"op": "argmin", "child": <set>,
  "key": "<KEY>"}   the single most/least extreme object
- {"op": "top1", "child": <set>}   the single best-matching object (use for a singular
  "the X")

<region> is one of:
- {"op": "image"}   the whole image
- {"op": "red_circle"}   the area inside a red circle drawn on the image
- {"op": "part", "part": "<DIR>"}   a part of the image frame
- {"op": "around", "child": <set>}   the area covered by some objects (e.g. inside a
  parking lot, on a field)

DIR: TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT, RIGHT, UL, UR, LL, LR, CENTER   (UL = upper/top left, UR =
  upper/top right, LL = lower/bottom left, LR = lower/bottom right)
KEY: X (left->right), Y (top->bottom), AREA (size), LENGTH (longest side)
Superlatives: leftmost = argmin X, rightmost = argmax X, topmost = argmin Y, bottommost =
  argmax Y, largest/biggest = argmax AREA, smallest = argmin AREA, longest = argmax
  LENGTH.

RULES:
- "cls" is a short detector phrase: the object noun plus its colour/shape words ("red
  car", "L-shaped black roof building", "white storage tank"). Use the singular noun.
  Never put positions, counts or relations inside "cls".
- Position words about the IMAGE frame ("in the top left corner of the picture", "on the
  right side of the image", "in the middle") become in_region with a part region. A
  position relative to ANOTHER object ("below the white building", "to the left of the
  bridge") becomes filter with that object as anchor.
- "inside / within the red circle (red-circled area)" becomes in_region with {"op":
  "red_circle"}.
- "in / on / along <a place such as a parking lot, field, road, river, harbor>" becomes
  in_region with an "around" region of that place.
- A singular referent ("the blue building", "the bridge") is wrapped in top1 unless a
  superlative already makes it single. A plural referent ("the three sports fields", "the
  cluster of houses") is NOT wrapped: its position is the centre of the group.
- For "where is A relative to / in relation to B", "what is the
  direction/position/orientation of A relative to B": target = A, reference = B.
- Keep context phrases that locate the scene ("In the parking lot under the black roof
  building ...") as in_region / filter constraints on BOTH target and reference when they
  apply to both.
- For whole-image counts ("in the entire image / picture") the set is just detect.

EXAMPLES:
Q: How many wind turbines are there inside the red circle?
{"answer_type": "count", "program": {"op": "count", "child": {"op": "in_region", "child":
  {"op": "detect", "cls": "wind turbine"}, "region": {"op": "red_circle"}}}}
Q: How many white trucks are there in the upper left corner of the picture?
{"answer_type": "count", "program": {"op": "count", "child": {"op": "in_region", "child":
  {"op": "detect", "cls": "white truck"}, "region": {"op": "part", "part": "UL"}}}}
Q: How many buses are parked in the parking lot to the right of the gray stadium?
{"answer_type": "count", "program": {"op": "count", "child": {"op": "in_region", "child":
  {"op": "detect", "cls": "bus"}, "region": {"op": "around", "child": {"op": "filter",
  "child": {"op": "detect", "cls": "parking lot"}, "pred": "RIGHT", "anchor": {"op":
  "top1", "child": {"op": "detect", "cls": "gray stadium"}}}}}}}

Relation prompt of the synthesiser You translate a question about the relative position of two objects in a large
  remote-sensing image into a STRICT JSON program (no markdown, no commentary, no
  <think>). You see only the question text, never the image and never the answer options.
  Output exactly one JSON object:
{"answer_type": "direction", "program": {"op": "direction", "target": <ref>, "reference":
  <ref>}}

The question asks where the TARGET is located relative to the REFERENCE ("where is A
  relative to / in relation to B", "what is the position/direction/orientation of A
  relative to B", "A is located in which direction of B": target = A, reference = B).

<ref> = {"op": "refer", "expr": "<referring expression>", "cls": "<head phrase>",
  "plural": true | false, "within": <container>}
- "within" (optional): the larger area that CONTAINS the object, when the question gives
  one. It is either an image-frame part {"op": "part", "part": "<DIR>"} ("in the top left
  corner of the picture", "on the right side of the image") or a place {"op": "refer",
  "expr": "<place expression with all of its own locating words>", "cls": "<place head
  phrase>", "plural": false} ("in the parking lot beneath the white building", "on the
  runway in the middle of the picture", "in the residential area on the left"). If a scene
  phrase applies to both objects ("In the parking lot under the black roof building, ...",
  "In the city on the right side of the image, ..."), give BOTH refs the same "within".
  Omit "within" when the question gives no containing area.
- "expr": the object’s own description, copied from the question words: its category,
  colour, shape and size words ("largest", "longer") and its relations to nearby objects
  ("near the river", "below the yellow buildings"), but WITHOUT the containing area
  already given in "within". Never put the other object’s relation to this one into expr
  ("relative to B" is not part of A’s expr).
- "cls": the short category phrase with colour/shape words only, singular ("white car",
  "L-shaped black roof building", "tennis court").
- "plural": true only when the expression denotes a group ("the two adjacent tennis
  courts", "the cluster of houses", "the three sports fields"); otherwise false.

DIR: TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT, RIGHT, UL, UR, LL, LR, CENTER   (UL = upper/top left, UR =
  upper/top right, LL = lower/bottom left, LR = lower/bottom right)

EXAMPLES:
Q: What is the position of the red bus at the top of the picture relative to the yellow
  bus near the gas station?
{"answer_type": "direction", "program": {"op": "direction", "target": {"op": "refer",
  "expr": "the red bus", "cls": "red bus", "plural": false, "within": {"op": "part",
  "part": "TOP"}}, "reference": {"op": "refer", "expr": "the yellow bus near the gas
  station", "cls": "yellow bus", "plural": false}}}
Q: On the runway in the middle of the picture, in which direction is the white airplane
  located relative to the gray airplane?
{"answer_type": "direction", "program": {"op": "direction", "target": {"op": "refer",
  "expr": "the white airplane", "cls": "white airplane", "plural": false, "within": {"op":
  "refer", "expr": "the runway in the middle of the picture", "cls": "runway", "plural":
  false}}, "reference": {"op": "refer", "expr": "the gray airplane", "cls": "gray
  airplane", "plural": false, "within": {"op": "refer", "expr": "the runway in the middle
  of the picture", "cls": "runway", "plural": false}}}}

The coverage check compares a counting program with the words of its question and never reads the options. It looks
for the words and phrases of Table S15 , ignoring case. In the reported configuration it runs on
MME-RealWorld counting only. A program that misses any of these words, or that the checker rejects, is synthesised
once more, with one of two notes appended to the question on a line of its own:

The executor asks the VLM four kinds of question. Each view is a crop of the original image, reduced to the pixel

and by in this image otherwise. Its reply, at most 12 tokens, is read as the first integer it contains, or else
as the smallest number word from zero to twelve that it contains. The class phrase is inserted as the program writes
it, usually in the singular.

blocks.en: S3.3 Fallback steps and RC re-counting

blocks.en:
Execution degrades in steps, following the fallback design of GeoSelect ( Jiang et al., 2026b ) . Table S16 lists every step of
the reported configuration with its trigger and the number of test questions in which it fired.

blocks.en:
A repair step rewrites common slips of the synthesiser, by fixed rules that keep the meaning, before the program is
checked. Direction words are mapped onto the nine tokens (Section S3.1 ), and a filter anchored on the image itself becomes in_region with the matching part. A filter whose predicate
names proximity, such as NEAR , NEXT_TO , BESIDE or ALONG , becomes near ,
and one whose predicate is no direction at all is removed. An argmax or argmin with an unknown key
becomes top1 , and a set given as a region becomes around that set.
On the test splits, repair changed 3 OSR and 92 counting programs, each of which the checker would otherwise have
rejected. In 43 of the counting programs it turned a proximity predicate into near .
For MME-RealWorld counting the checker then rejected 13 programs and the coverage check flagged 458, and each of these
questions was synthesised once more. The second program replaced 4 of the rejected programs and 93 of the flagged
ones, 58 of which then missed no word. Of the other flagged programs, 350 were kept because the second program missed
as many words or more, and 15 because it was ill typed. The missing words were place nouns in 257 of the 458
questions, positions in 255, colour words in 49 and shape words in 40.

A class phrase is grounded coarse to fine when the pixel budget shrinks the sides of its window to 60% of their

pixels and three times their size. A box that its close-up does not confirm is dropped, unless every box would be, and
if the reduced view yields no box at all, the window is searched in tiles of about 3,000 pixels.
A referring expression that yields no box is replaced by its class phrase, which happened for 122 of the 793 OSR
referents grounded on the test split, in 108 questions. If a place container is not found, or the referent is not
found in the window around it, the referent is searched for in the whole image with the place phrase appended to its
expression. On OSR this happened in 10 test questions. In the OSR configuration an image-part container is always
handled this way, because image parts are visible in the whole-image view.

If an anchor or place of a counting program is not found, it is searched for again without its colour and shape words,

that 50 of the questions could be executed. In 3 more questions an anchor or place was not found and had nothing to
drop. On the development split, removing the coverage check and relaxation together lowered counting accuracy from 43.3
to 42.4 and raised the share of abstentions from 2.4 to 6.1%.

The drawn circle is found in a copy of the image reduced to 2,500 pixels on its longer side. Pixels with a red value

circle was not found in 3 of the 80 RC test images, and GeoScope abstained on these questions.
A count that equals no option value is taken twice more. The first extra view shows the bounding box of the circle
enlarged by 30% on each side, and the second shows the original window enlarged, by at most four times, until its longer
side has 1,536 pixels. The median of the three counts is used. Re-counting uses the values of the options, never
their order or letters, and the VLM never sees them. It fired for 24 of the 77 executed RC questions. It changed the
count in two of them and the chosen option in one, which was wrong before and after, so RC accuracy is the same
without it.

When every step fails, GeoScope abstains and returns the answer of the zero-shot VLM at 4 M pixels
(Section 5.2 ). On OSR it abstained on 14 questions because a referent was not found, 3 because both
referents were grounded on the same box, which leaves no direction, and 1 because its program was ill typed. On
MME-RealWorld counting, 9 programs remained ill typed, 7 anchors or places were not found, and 3 regions were empty.
Two of them were relative regions less than 8 pixels wide inside the region containing them, and one did not overlap
the region containing it. The zero-shot answers are correct for 1 of the 3 RC, 3 of the 18 OSR and 8 of the 19
counting questions on which it abstained. With LLaVA-OV-7B as the perception model, GeoScope abstains on 182 of
the 400 OSR test questions, mostly because one of the two referents is not found.

blocks.en: S3.4 Program correctness and coverage
blocks.zh: S3.4 方案的正确性和覆盖面

blocks.en:
We wrote reference programs by hand for 150 questions, 30 test questions per task and 30 development questions each
for OSR and MME-RealWorld counting. For each we judged whether the synthesised program expresses every constraint of
the question, without looking at the answer. All 30 RC programs are acceptable, as are 34 of the 60 OSR programs and
27 of the 60 counting programs. Most faults are simplifications. Of the 33 faulty counting programs, 16 drop the place
and keep the image part, so that the parking lot in the lower right becomes the lower right, and 10 write a relation
the question does not state. OSR programs most often attach a scene condition to only one of the two objects, in 9
cases, or add a direction the question does not name, in 7. Questions with acceptable and unacceptable
programs are answered correctly at similar rates, 41% and 42% for counting and 44% and 38% for OSR. Replacing the synthesised programs by the hand-written ones on the test questions changes accuracy by at most two
of thirty per task, from 19, 11 and 11 correct answers to 19, 13 and 11 for RC, OSR and counting.

用于OSR和MME-RealWorld计数. 对于每一个我们判断 合成程序是否表达 每一个限制
这个问题,不看答案。 所有30个驻地协调员方案都是可以接受的,60个业务社会责任方案中的34个也是可以接受的。

问题没有说明。 OSR程序最常将一个场景条件附加到两个对象中的一个,在9中
在7个案例中,或者添加一个问题没有标明的方向。 不可接受的问题
以相同的比率正确回答方案,计数为41%和42%,业务社保为44%和38%。 由手写程序在测试题上替换合成程序, 最多改变两个问题的精度
每个任务30个,从19个、11个和11个正确答案到19个、13个和11个,分别是驻地协调员、业务SR和计数。

Of the 245 development counting questions, 43 use constructions the grammar lacks, mostly words for the state or
action of an object, ordinals and between . Their simplified programs are answered correctly in 51.2% of the
cases, against 41.6% for the other questions.

blocks.en: S3.5 Prompt sensitivity and choice of synthesiser
blocks.zh: S3.5 即时敏感性和合成器的选择

blocks.en:
We changed each synthesis prompt in two ways and ran the development split with the rest of the configuration
unchanged. The first variant removes the guidance, which is the RULES block of the counting prompt and the four lines
that explain the fields of a referring expression in the relation prompt. The second keeps every other worked example,
five of ten and three of six.
Table S17 gives the results. RC programs did not change at all. For OSR and counting, 33 to
61% of the programs stayed identical, and two of the four variants were significantly less accurate: OSR with every
other example by 10.0 points and counting without the guidance by 6.1. The guidance of the counting prompt and the
examples of the relation prompt are thus needed, and the programs depend on the wording of the prompt.

不变。 第一个变体删除了引导,即计数即时的规则块和四行
用于解释关系提示中引用表达式的字段。 第二种模式让其他榜样都保持了
5个10个,3个6个

61%的方案保持不变,四个变体中有两个更准确:
其他例子以10.0分计算,没有6.1分的指导。 即时计数的指引和
因此,需要以实例说明关系是否迅速,而程序取决于关系是否迅速。

blocks.en:
Table S18 replaces Qwen3-4B by five other synthesisers and keeps everything else, the prompts
included. Two are vision–language models, Qwen3-VL-4B and the perception model Qwen3-VL-8B, each given the question
alone or the question and the image at 4 M pixels. The other three are text models from other families, the dense
transformers Phi-4-mini ( Abouelenin et al., 2025 ) and Llama-3.2-3B, a smaller model of the Llama 3 family ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , and the state-space model
Falcon3-Mamba-7B, a continued pre-training of Falcon Mamba 7B ( Zuo et al., 2024 ) . An ill-typed program goes through the same fallback steps as in GeoScope (Section S3.3 ).
No synthesiser does better than Qwen3-4B. The vision–language models lose 4 to 7 points on OSR, none significantly on
100 questions, and 3.7 to 5.7 points on counting. The loss on counting is significant for Qwen3-VL-8B, with
differences of − 5.7 -5.7 [ − 10.6 -10.6 , − 0.8 -0.8 ] points without the image and − 5.3 -5.3 [ − 10.2 -10.2 , − 0.8 -0.8 ] with it. Showing the
image changes accuracy by + 0.4 +0.4 to + 3.0 +3.0 points, and none of the four paired intervals excludes zero, the largest
gain being + 3.0 +3.0 [ − 1.0 -1.0 , + 8.0 +8.0 ] on OSR for Qwen3-VL-8B.
The image raises the share of well-typed programs of Qwen3-VL-4B from 79 to 89% on OSR and from 86 to 93% on
counting. Without the image, 74 of the 245 counting programs of Qwen3-VL-8B are ill typed. Phi-4-mini writes
well-typed programs for 98, 91 and 100% of the OSR, counting and RC questions, Llama-3.2-3B for 57, 56 and 20%, and

blocks.en: Appendix S4 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 附录S4 评价协议

blocks.en: S4.1 Splits
blocks.zh: S4.1 分块

blocks.en:
Each task is split once by a fixed rule, and the split is stored with its questions. The question identifiers of the
task are sorted and shuffled with Python’s random.Random , seeded with the string 0- followed by the
task name, for instance 0-OSR . The first 20% of the shuffled identifiers, rounded to the nearest integer,
form the development split, and the remaining 80% the held-out test split. RC is thus split into 20 development and 80 test
questions, OSR into 100 and 400, and MME-RealWorld counting into 245 and 981. The same rule splits the 13 other tasks
we evaluate, from 12 and 48 questions for the smallest XLRS-Bench subtasks to 251 and 1,006 for MME-RealWorld
position. Applying the rule to the stored question files reproduces the stored split of all 16 tasks.
Every RC and MME-RealWorld counting question has its own image, so these splits share no image. Of the 400 OSR test
questions, 32 use an image that a development question also uses. Without them GeoScope scores 44.02 against 34.51
for zero-shot answering, and resampling images instead of questions gives the gain of 10.5 points an interval of
[4.3, 16.7], against [4.2, 16.8].
The splits of RC, OSR, XLRS-Bench overall counting and MME-RealWorld counting were drawn before the first experiment.
blocks.zh:
每项任务被固定规则分出一次,分出时会随所问而存储. 问题识别标志
任务按照 Python 的随机排序和洗牌。 随机,以字符串0为种子,然后是
任务名称,例如 0-OSR 。 头20%的被冲洗的识别器, 四舍五入到最近的整数,
组成开发拆分,其余80%的被搁置测试拆分. 因此,驻地协调员分为20个开发和80个测试
OSR分为100和400,MME-RealWorld计数分为245和981。 同一规则将其他13个任务分开
我们从最小的XLRS-Bench子任务的12个和48个问题,到MME-RealWorld的251个和1 006个问题进行评估。
立场。 将规则应用到被存储的问题文件中,复制了所有16个任务的被存储分拆.
每个RC和MME-RealWorld计数问题都有自己的图像,因此这些分块没有共享图像. 在400 OSR测试中
问题,32使用一个发展问题也使用的形象. 没有它们 GeoScope 得分44.02比34.51
用于零发答题,重新模拟图像而不是问题,使10.5分的得分间隔为:
[4.3, 16.7],对[4.2, 16.8]。
RC,OSR,XLRS-Bench总体计数和MME-RealWorld计数的分数是在第一次实验前绘制的.

blocks.en: Every configuration was fixed before it was run on a test split.
blocks.zh: 每个配置在测试分拆运行前都是固定的.

blocks.en: S4.2 Leakage checks
blocks.zh: S4.2 泄漏检查

blocks.en:
The crops of the counting horizon (Section 3.1 ) come from DOTA-v1.5 training
images ( Xia et al., 2018 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) , a source that XLRS-Bench and MME-RealWorld also draw on. When the images were chosen, every DOTA
image named in the benchmark question files then in use was left out. After the measurement we compared the images of
both DOTA crop sets with the 1,220 DOTA images named in all 3,080 XLRS-Bench and 3,738 MME-RealWorld remote
sensing questions, and found none in common. FAIR1M, DIOR and VisDrone, the other sources of horizon crops
(Section S2.5 and Section S2.4 ), are used by neither benchmark. The image paths of
the two benchmarks name only DOTA, MiniFrance, HRSCD, Potsdam, ITCVD and Toronto.
blocks.zh:
计数地平线的作物(第3.1节)来自DOTA-v1.5培训
相片 (Xia等, 2018; Ding等, 2022),是XLRS-Bench和MME-RealWorld也借鉴的一个来源. 当图像被选中时, 每个 DOTA
基准问题文件中命名的图像被忽略。 测量之后,我们比较了
DOTA的收割机和所有3 080个XLRS-Bench和3 738个MME-RealWorld遥控器中命名的1 220个DOTA图像
并发现没有共同点。 FAIR1M、DIOR和VisDrone是地平线作物的其他来源
(S2.5节和S2.4节),两个基准都没有使用。 图像路径
这两个基准的名称仅指DOTA、Mini France、HRSCD、Potsdam、ITCVD和多伦多。

blocks.en:
The two synthesis prompts hold 16 worked examples. Four questions appear in both, so the examples ask 12 distinct
questions. We compared each example with the 4,398 questions of RC, OSR, XLRS-Bench overall counting and
MME-RealWorld counting, position and colour, of both splits, by the similarity ratio of Python’s difflib on
lower-cased letters and digits. No example equals a benchmark question. Four have a ratio above 0.85, all because they
follow a benchmark sentence pattern with other objects. The other ratios are at most 0.80. The closest pair, at 0.96,
is the example How many white trucks are there in the upper left corner of the picture? and the test question How many white cars are there in the upper left corner of the picture?
blocks.zh:
两个综合提示有16个行之有效的例子。 4个问题都出现在两个中,因此例子提出了12个不同的问题。
问. 我们把每个例子与驻地协调员、业务SR、XLRS-Bench的4 398个问题作了比较。
用 Python difflib 的相近比例来计算两个分数的 MME- RealWorld 位置和颜色
小写字母和数字。 无一例等于基准问题. 4人的比例高于0.85 因为他们
与其他对象一起遵循基准句式。 其他比率最高为0.80。 最接近的对,为0.96
是实例 照片左上角有多少辆白色卡车? 和测试问题 图片左上角有多少辆白色汽车?.

blocks.en:
The guidance lines of the prompts quote short phrases as illustrations. Most of them, such as near the
river or the cluster of houses , occur in questions of both splits. Two occur in test questions only, L-shaped black roof building in OSR question 75 and below the yellow buildings in OSR question 272.
We had read both questions in a random sample of all questions that we drew to describe the data. GeoScope answers
both wrongly, and without them its OSR test accuracy is 44.22 instead of 44.00.
blocks.zh:
提示的引导行引用了短句作为插图. 他们中的大多数,例如靠近
河流或一连串房屋都发生在两地分割的问题中。 两个只出现在测试问题中,L-形状为OSR问题75的黑色屋顶建筑和OSR问题272的黄色建筑下方.
我们从我们为描述数据而抽取的所有问题中随机抽取了两个问题。 GeoScope 答案
两者都是错误的,没有它们,它的OSR测试精度是44.22而不是44.00.

blocks.en: S4.3 Zero-shot protocol
blocks.zh: S4.3 零发协议

blocks.en:
Our zero-shot reference for Qwen3-VL-8B is well above the MME-RealWorld numbers that other papers report for the
same model, 56.41 on position, 48.07 on colour and 21.35 on counting ( Ma et al., 2026b ) , values that Zhang et al. (2026c) also reports and Jiang et al. (2026a) reports to one decimal.
To see where the difference comes from, we answered the development split with five protocols
(Table S19 ). The first is ours, the image at 4 M pixels and the option letter chosen by the logit of
the first answer token. The second keeps input and prompt but generates an answer of up to 64 tokens and parses the
letter from it. The third is ours at 1 M pixels. The last two use the prompt and answer extraction of MME-RealWorld’s
official evaluation, copied from VLMEvalKit, at 4 M and at 1 M pixels.
blocks.zh:
Quen3-VL-8B的零射入比 远高于其他报纸报道的MME-RealWorld数字
同型号,位置为56.41,颜色为48.07,计数为21.35(马等,2026b.),张等(2026c.)也报告的值和江等(2026a.)报告的值为一等分.
我们用五个协议 来回答开发的分歧
(表S19) (中文(简体) ). 第一个是我们的,图像在 4 M 像素和选择的选项字母 由登录
第一个回答符号。 第二段保持输入和快速,但生成最多64个令牌的答案,并解析
从它的信。 第三种是1M像素 后两者使用MME-RealWorld的即时和解答取出
官方评价,复制自VLMEvalKit,在4M和1M像素.

blocks.en: Table S19: Qwen3-VL-8B zero-shot on the development split under five protocols (accuracy, %).
blocks.zh: 表S19: Quen3-VL-8B在5个协议(精确度,%)下对开发拆分的零镜头.

blocks.en:
The input size accounts for most of the difference. Going from 4 M to 1 M pixels costs 11.2 points on position,
10.8 on colour and 9.4 on counting. The way of answering matters much less. At 4 M pixels a generated answer or the
official prompt and extraction move the three MME-RealWorld tasks by at most 2.9 points. With the official protocol at
1 M pixels we obtain 61.75, 56.97 and 19.59, within 9 points of the reported numbers. On RC and OSR, whose development splits hold 20
and 100 questions, the protocols differ by amounts that such small sets cannot resolve.
blocks.zh:
输入大小占了大部分差异. 从4M到1M像素在位置上花费11.2分,
颜色是10.8,计数是9.4。 答之道更无所取. 4 Mixels 生成的答案或
官方的即时取出将MME-RealWorld三项任务以最多2.9分移动. 正式协议在
1个 混合像素,我们得到61.75,56.97和19.59,在报告数字的9个点之内. RC和OSR的开发分裂占20个
和100个问题, 协议的金额不同 这些小集不能解决。

blocks.en: S4.4 Constant-answer baseline
blocks.zh: S4.4 常答基线

blocks.en:
The constant-answer baseline answers every question of a task with the same option position, a letter, or the same
option-value rank, such as the largest number, whichever is most often correct on the development split. On RC the
smallest number and letter A tie there with 8 of 20 correct, on OSR letters A and C with 30 of 100, and on XLRS-Bench
overall counting letters B, C and D and the largest and second-largest numbers with 4 of 12. We break such ties by the test score,
so the baseline is an upper bound for the tied choices; breaking them by the first option letter instead gives 26.25
on RC and 22.50 on OSR.
blocks.zh:
恒答基线以相同的选项位置、字母或相同方式解答每个任务的问题
选项值排名,如最大数字,以开发拆分时最常正确者为准。 关于驻地协调员
最小数字和字母 A 的平局 20 的 8 的正确, OSR 的字母 A 和 C 有 30 的 100 的 , 以及 XLRS- Bench
总的计算字母为B、C和D,最大和第二大的数字为12个中4个。 我们通过测试分数打破这种联系
因此,基线是捆绑选择的上限; 以第一个选项字母打破它们, 而不是给出26.25。
(原始内容存档于2019-03-25) (中文(简体) ). RC.

blocks.en: Appendix S5 Reproduced methods
blocks.zh: 附录S5 复制的方法

blocks.en: S5.1 Selection of methods
blocks.zh: S5.1 方法的选择

blocks.en:
For each task we reproduce, with its official code, the training-free method with the strongest result reported on
that task by early October 2026. We count a method as training-free if none of its components was trained by its
authors, while frozen models trained by others are allowed. Table S20 lists the results behind
the choice.
blocks.zh:
每一个任务,我们用其正式代码, 无训练方法,报告的结果最强
在2026年10月初之前完成这项任务。 我们把一种方法算作无训练,如果它的所有部件都没有经过训练
作者,而被他人训练的被冻结的模型则被允许. 表S20列出了后面的结果
选择

blocks.en:
On RC the strongest result is WeaveEarth’s 47.0, measured by RS-OPSD ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) , since WeaveEarth itself reports
RC only merged with overall counting into one category. On OSR and on XLRS-Bench as a whole the strongest results are
GazeEarth’s 37.8 and 53.51, the latter by question. On MME-RealWorld counting, the table of
ZoomSearch ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) lists 40.25 for RAP and 39.15 for ZoomSearch, both with LLaVA-OneVision-7B, and we
reproduce both. RAP reports no remote sensing results itself ( Wang et al., 2025e ) . Its code supports Qwen3-VL-8B, so we also
run it with GeoScope’s backbone. WeaveEarth, GazeEarth and ZoomSearch report MME-RealWorld position and colour as
well, and we run them on these two tasks too (Section S6.2 ).

在RC方面,最强的结果是由RS-OPSD(Jiang等人,2026a)测量的WeaveEarth的47.0。

blocks.en:
The lower block of Table S20 lists the methods we do not reproduce. ZoomEye ( Shen et al., 2025 ) ,
RADAR ( Liu et al., 2026d ) and ImageRAG ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) report counting results below those of RAP and ZoomSearch, and
the results ImageRAG reports for itself use an answering model fine-tuned by its authors. DualComp ( Li et al., 2026b ) and SA-GEM ( Ma et al., 2026a ) compress or prune visual tokens under a router trained offline by their authors. They fall outside the
training-free track, although SA-GEM’s 41.6 would otherwise be the strongest result on OSR. Concurrent work without

blocks.en: S5.2 Settings of the reproduced methods
blocks.zh: S5.2 复制方法的设置

blocks.en:
Table S21 summarises the runs. Each training-free method runs its released inference code,
with the changes described below for each method, on the test questions of the listed tasks, with greedy decoding and
its own answer extraction. Our wrappers load the questions, write one record per question and, where needed, move models between GPU and host memory.
Each of these runs used one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 with 24 GiB, the GPU of our own experiments. The re-run of the trained
Text-Before-Vision is described in Section S5.5 . Methods built on Qwen3-VL-8B load the same copy of
Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as GeoScope. ZoomSearch and RAP load the original
LLaVA-OneVision-7B checkpoint through their own code, while our zero-shot and GeoScope runs with this model use its
transformers release with the model’s default system message. An answer from which a method’s extraction recovers no
option letter counts as wrong.
blocks.zh:
表S21概述了运行情况。 每一种无训练方法都使用其释放的推论代码,
每种方法的如下改动,关于所列任务的测试问题,以及贪婪的解码和
它自己的答案提取。 我们的包装器装入了问题,每个问题写出一则记录,并在必要时在GPU和主机内存之间移动模型.
这些运行都使用了一个NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090与24个GiB,即我们自己的实验的GPU. 训练有素者的重跑
第S.5.5节介绍了 " 文字展望 " 。 在Quen3-VL-8B上构建的方法装入相同的副本
Quen3-VL-8B-作为GeoScope的指令. 缩放搜索和RAP 装入原始
LLaVA-One Vision-7B检查点通过自己的代码,而我们的"零射"和"GeoScope"使用这个模型运行.

blocks.en: Table S21: Settings of the reproduced methods, each run with its official code on the test split of the listed tasks, and Text-Before-Vision on all questions.
blocks.zh: 表S-21: 妇女 所复制方法的设置,每个方法在所列出任务的测试分拆上用其官方代码运行,所有问题的Text-Before-Vision运行.

blocks.en:
We import its only inference script, written for open-ended
questions, with all its default settings. The script has no multiple-choice template, so its question slot receives
the question, the lettered options and the instruction to answer with the option’s letter, the same text that RAP
receives. Its prompt also names the question category, which we set to the benchmark’s own task label, such as regional counting or count . For MME-RealWorld position and colour we use position and color . The released requirements pin a transformers
version that cannot load Qwen3-VL, so we use version 4.57.1. The SigLIP2 encoder that scores the tiles truncates its
text at 64 tokens, which cuts the options and the instruction from 319 of the 400 OSR and 870 of the 981 counting
queries, and we left this unchanged. Peak memory stays below 21.4 GiB, so no change was needed to fit the GPU.
blocks.zh:
我们输入它唯一的推论脚本,写在开放的
问题,包含所有默认设置。 脚本没有多选择模板,所以它的问档收到
问题、字母选项和用选项字母回答的指示,与区域行动方案相同的文本
接收。 它的即时性也命名了问题类别,我们设定了基准本身的任务标签,如区域计数或计数。 对于MME-RealWorld的位置和颜色,我们使用位置和颜色. 释放的要求将一个变压器钉住
不能装入Quen3-VL的版本,所以我们使用4.57.1版本. SigLIP2 编码器对牌子的分数
文本为64个令牌,它削减了400 OSR中的319个和981个计数中的870个选项和指令
问,我们没有改变。 峰值内存会保持在21.4 GiB以下,因此不需要修改来适应GPU.

blocks.en:
We use its released configurations for MME-RealWorld and
XLRS-Bench, which agree in every setting of the method. The frozen model selects at most two cells of a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid on a 1,536-pixel overview and answers from a foveated 2,048-pixel view. Its answer prompt asks for the
reasoning before the answer, within 1,024 generated tokens, and its own matcher scores the answer. Of its 981
counting answers, 68 were cut off at this limit before giving an answer. Questions that state a pixel box skip the
selection call. GazeEarth resamples the original pixels, so it always receives the original image. For the eight
XLRS-Bench subtasks outside counting and spatial relations, it receives the original images of the XLRS-Bench-lite
release. Two changes were needed for the code to run. The overall land-use questions have several correct letters,

On XLRS-Bench, GazeEarth answers 976 of the 2,464 held-out questions correctly, 39.61%, and reports 53.51% on all
questions. Its backbone answers 46.71% zero-shot. GazeEarth falls below the backbone on seven of the 13 subtasks.
It falls most on object classification and object colour, 35.31 and 31.56 against 48.44 and 43.44 on 1,280 questions
together, and on counting with change detection, 20.83 against 43.75. It is above the backbone on five, most on
route planning and environmental condition reasoning, by 8.8 and 7.5 points.

blocks.en: S5.4 Gains against each method’s own baselines

blocks.en:
GazeEarth’s code contains two baselines with the same backbone and answer prompt: an overview, which answers from
the whole image reduced to 2,048 pixels on the long side, and direct answering from the native image through the
backbone’s processor. We ran the overview on six tasks, the three of Table 4 , overall counting and
MME-RealWorld position and colour. We ran direct answering on MME-RealWorld position, where GazeEarth reports a gain of
14.7 points over it, second only to its 15.6 on colour (Table S23 ).

blocks.en: S5.5 Text-Before-Vision
blocks.zh: S5.5 文字展望

blocks.en:
Text-Before-Vision ( Wang et al., 2026a ) fine-tunes Qwen2.5-VL-7B and then trains it with reinforcement learning to
zoom into the image with a crop tool. It reports 60.40 on XLRS-Bench, the mean accuracy of 32 sampled answers per
question, without results per subtask. We ran its released checkpoint with its released
evaluation code on all 3,080 questions as prepared by its own data script. We ran it in
its two modes: greedy, with up to 1,024 tokens per turn, and sampled, with one answer per question
at temperature 0.7 and up to 10,240 tokens per turn, which estimates its Pass@1 without bias. In both, the model may call the crop tool at every turn,
for at most eleven turns in the greedy script and ten in the sampled one. For safety, the checkpoint shards are read
without running pickled code and the tool calls are parsed as literals instead of being evaluated; neither change
alters the computation. The model is
served with vLLM on two NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs with tensor parallelism of two, as in its script, and with its full context of
128,000 tokens. We disabled video input, which the evaluation never sends, and reserved 80% of the GPU memory.

blocks.en:
The two rules differ in how they read a reply (Table S24 ). Ours takes one answer per question, as for
every method: the letter in the answer tag or, if the tag is missing, the last “Answer: X” of the reply.
Text-Before-Vision’s own scoring code takes every standalone letter of the reply, the article “a” included, and counts a single-choice
answer as correct when any of them is the answer. With greedy decoding only 544 of the 3,080 replies close the
answer tag. The other 2,536 end with a line “Answer: X” instead, and for each of them its code re-sends the same
request up to ten times. Over the greedy replies its scoring gives 59.54, close to the 60.40 it reports, and ours
50.54. With sampling every reply closes the tag, and both rules give 47.47. One sample per question
estimates the Pass@1 that the paper reports, with a standard error of at most 1.3 points, so the 12.9 points between 47.47
and the reported 60.40 are not sampling noise. The model calls the crop tool 50 times in the greedy run and 107 times
in the sampled one, over 3,080 questions each.

On the held-out 80%, where Text-Before-Vision scores 50.54 greedy and 48.15 sampled under our rule, GeoScope’s 59.53

blocks.en: S6.1 XLRS-Bench by subtask
blocks.zh: S6.1 XLRS- Bench 按子任务

blocks.en:
Table S25 lists the 13 subtasks of XLRS-Bench-lite on all 3,080 questions and on the held-out
80%, 2,464 questions. Three routes answer them. Typed programs answer RC, OSR and overall counting. The three
object-property subtasks give the target as a pixel box and are answered from a close-up around it
(Section 4.5 ). Qwen3-VL-8B answers the other seven subtasks zero-shot, so GeoScope’s accuracy
there equals the zero-shot column.

(第4.5节). Qwen3-VL-8B 回答其他七个子任务的零发, 所以 GeoScope 的准确性
这里等于零射出一列。

blocks.en:
The zero-shot protocol is that of Section 5.2 with two adjustments, both fixed before the test
questions were run. The change-detection questions give the model both images of the pair. The 100 overall land-use
questions, 97 of which have several correct options, are answered by generating letters and scored by exact match
of the letter set, the rule of GazeEarth’s scorer.

字母集,GazeEarth的计分规则。

blocks.en:
The pixel-box route renders a close-up centred on the box, three times its longer side and at least 512 pixels wide.
It outlines the box in red and shows the whole image, also outlined, as a first view. The rendering was chosen among
three on the 332 development questions of the three subtasks. The close-up alone reached 74.10, the outlined
close-up 85.24 and the outlined close-up with the whole image 86.75, against 39.16 for zero-shot answering.

Averaged over the 13 subtasks, GeoScope reaches 59.98 on all questions and 59.53 on the held-out questions, against

subtasks ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . The trained Text-Before-Vision
reports 60.40 from sampled answers, against 47.47 when we re-run its sampling (Section S5.5 ).

blocks.en: S6.5 Test-split ablations by true count

blocks.en:
Table S31 gives the counting ablations of Table 8 on the test split, by the true
number of objects N N . We recompute each region count from the VLM answers recorded in the test runs, under three
rules. The final rule accepts a count within the horizon unless it is a
zero from a downsampled view. A second rule also accepts such zeros, and a third, without subdivision, counts once
every view that the program first renders. Under the final rule every recomputed count and answer equals the original, and every rule uses only recorded
answers. Questions answered by the fallback keep their
answer under every rule. The same option matching maps each count to an option, and the intervals come from a paired
bootstrap with 10,000 resamples.

对象编号 N N 。 我们从测试中记录的 VLM 答案中重新计算出每个区域 低于3
规则。 最终规则接受地平线内的计数,除非是
零 从下取样视图。 第二种规则也接受这样的零, 第三个,没有分区,算一次
程序首先得出的每一个视图。 在最终规则下,每个重算和回答都等于原作,每个规则只使用记录
答对. 倒计时者回答的问题
回答每个规则。 将地图匹配到一个选项的相同选项,间隔来自一对
带一万个复标的靴子

blocks.en:
With programs and Qwen3-VL-8B, neither of the other two rules has a significant effect, overall or in any stratum. When the whole image is
counted, as in the run without programs, the trade-off of Proposition 1 appears. Removing subdivision
then costs 4.6 points [0.4, 8.8] on the 261 questions with 6 to 20 objects and gains 2.1 [ − 0.1 -0.1 , 4.4] on the
700 with at most five. Accepting such zeros costs 3.8 and gains 2.4 on the same questions. Within the regions that
programs name, the losses on 6 to 20 objects shrink to 2.7 points for subdivision and 1.9 for accepting such zeros,
neither significant. Qwen3-VL-4B undercounts more strongly, with an exponent of 0.64 against 0.76 on DOTA crops. Removing subdivision costs it 2.2 points
[0.6, 4.0] overall and 5.4 [1.1, 9.6] on 6 to 20 objects. Only 15 test questions ask for more than twenty
objects, and Qwen3-VL-8B loses two of them without subdivision, with or without programs. On OSR, replacing the
direction-relation matrix by the centre angle on the same boxes changes accuracy by − 2.0 -2.0 [ − 5.5 -5.5 , 1.5] with
Qwen3-VL-8B and − 1.8 -1.8 [ − 4.5 -4.5 , 1.0] with Qwen3-VL-4B.

计算,如在无程序运行中,建议1的取舍出现. 删除分区
然后在261个问题上花费4.6分[0.4,8.8],其中6至20个对象和收益2.1[−0.1-0.1,4.4]。
700个最多5个 接受这种零成本3.8,并在相同问题上得到2.4。 在那些
程序名称、6至20个物体的损失缩小为分数2.7分和接受这种零数1.9分,
两者都不重要。 Qune3-VL-4B更是低估了,DOTA作物的指数为0.64比0.76. 删除分区费用2.2分
[0.6, 4.0] 总体上和6至20个物体上的 5.4 [1.1, 9.6]. 只有15个试题问二十多个
对象,而Qwen3-VL-8B失去其中两个没有子分区,有或没有程序. 在OSR上,替换

Qune3-VL-8B和−1.8-1.8 [−4.5-4.5,1.0] 与 Qune3-VL-4B.

blocks.en:
The fixed grid needs new answers. For every question whose program counted one region, we tiled the counted region
into the cells of the test run, split each cell into a 4 × \times 4 grid as the executor splits views, counted every
part with the same question, view and pixel budget, and matched the sum to an option as before. Every other question keeps its
recorded answer. Subdivision, re-run in the same way on 20 of these questions, reproduced every original count. Over
the test split the grid lowers accuracy by 2.9 points [ − 0.1 -0.1 , 5.8], with 15.8 VLM calls per counted question against
about 14 for subdivision. It picks the largest number offered for 64% of the questions about at most five objects,
against 33%, and gains 20.7 points [14.9, 26.6] on the 222 questions whose answer is the largest number offered while
losing 9.8 [6.5, 13.1] on the 754 others. By the true number of objects, the grid loses 8.0 points [4.1, 11.7] on the 700 questions with at most five objects and gains 11.5
[6.9, 16.1] on the 261 with 6 to 20 (Table S31 ). Both changes follow from where the correct number sits among the options. The gain
comes mostly from the 128 questions with 6 to 20 objects whose answer is the largest number offered, where it
reaches 18.0 points [10.9, 25.8], against 5.3 [0.0, 10.5] on the other 133. For questions about at most five objects
the median count of the grid is 2.7 times the truth and 15% of its counts lie within 20% of the truth, against an
exact median and 24% for subdivision. On the 48 test questions of XLRS-Bench overall counting the grid needs 172 calls

blocks.en: S6.6 Direct answers on the program’s window
blocks.zh: S6.6 程序窗口的直接答案

blocks.en:
To separate where a program looks from what it computes there, the backbone answered each test question directly on
the window its program chose, with the question and its options and the first-token scores of the option letters.
The windows are those recorded in the test runs. On RC the window is the crop that
was counted, at 1 M pixels. On OSR it is the union of the boxes of the two referents, enlarged to 1.3 times its
longer side and to at least 768 pixels, at 2.5 M pixels. On MME-RealWorld counting it is the counted region with its
margin, at 2.5 M pixels; the 51 programs that count grounded boxes have no region and are left out. Only questions
whose program executed are compared, with GeoScope’s executed answer before any fallback (Table S32 ).
A direct answer takes one VLM call, against a median of two, five and seven calls for GeoScope on RC, OSR and
counting (Section 6.5 ). On MME-RealWorld the direct answer picks the option stating that the image does not show
the number for 31% of the questions, so the table also gives the highest-scoring numeric option.

blocks.en: S6.7 InternVL3.5-8B as the perception model
blocks.zh: S6.7 作为感知模型的实习生VL3.5-8B

blocks.en:
To see whether GeoScope depends on the Qwen family, we replaced its perception model by
InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025d ) on the development split. The synthesiser, prompts, parsers and parameters stay as
they are, and boxes use the same coordinates from 0 to 1,000. InternVL3.5 receives the default system message of its
own chat template. Its zero-shot answers at 4 M pixels, scored by first-token letter logits, serve as reference and
fallback. Table S33 gives the results.

为了了解GeoScope是否取决于Quen家族,我们用它的感觉模型取而代之的是:
InternVL3.5-8B (Wang等,2025d.) 关于开发分裂. 合成器、提示、解析器和参数保持不变
箱子使用相同的坐标 从0到1000。 InternVL3.5接收它的默认系统消息
拥有聊天模板。 它的零射出4个像素的答案,由一键字母对数计分,作为参考和
倒计时。 表S33列出了结果。

blocks.en:
With InternVL3.5-8B, GeoScope gains 13.1 points [6.1, 19.6] on counting, and its accuracy is not significantly different from
that of GeoScope with Qwen3-VL-8B, − 2.4 -2.4 [ − 8.6 -8.6 , 3.7], although GeoScope was tuned on this split with Qwen3-VL-8B. On OSR its gain of 5.0 is not significant, and it
abstains on 15 of the 100 questions, 13 of them because no direction could be computed. On counting it abstains on 45
of the 245 questions, 28 of them because the count InternVL3.5 returned could not be parsed. On RC it gains nothing and
stays 20 points below GeoScope with Qwen3-VL-8B. RC asks mostly about small sets, with a median of three objects, and on DOTA crops InternVL3.5-8B
overcounts one or two objects by 127% on average (Table S5 ).

对100个问题中的15个投弃权票,其中13个是因为无法计算方向。 数到45就弃权了

blocks.en:
We use the test split of the five task types in Table 7 , 1,369 questions, and the
validation split of the same task types, 100 questions each, whose images the test split does not use. The public
release lacks 105 of the SODA-A images these questions use. We took them from the SODA-A release ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) by
their file number; three images present in both releases are identical pixel by pixel. All questions are evaluated.

The benchmark’s code for direct answering runs on several large GPUs and its output
instructions are not released. We re-run Qwen3-VL-8B on one RTX 3090 with its released image preprocessing (up to
16,777,216 pixels), its conversion of pixel coordinates in a question to a 0–1,000 grid, the question followed
by its closing instruction, greedy decoding, and its released parser and metric. Every answer is parsed. The re-run
lies within 3.4 points of the reported scores on four task types and 7.5 points above on conditional counting
(Table 7 ). InternVL3.5-8B is re-run with its own preprocessing, up to 12 tiles of 448 × 448 448\times 448 pixels and a thumbnail, and otherwise in the same way; it lies within 4.4 points of the reported scores on all five
task types. We compare GeoScope with the re-run of its backbone, question by question.

blocks.en:
The counting programs run with the frozen configuration of MME-RealWorld counting. Of the 544
regional counting questions, 461 give the region as a pixel box. For them the program counts the class in that box,
which needed one addition to the program language, a region given by its corners; the other 83 describe the region
in words and are synthesised like every counting question. On the validation split, the usual 15% view margin
around a given box scored 48.30 against 45.34 without it on the 84 questions with a box, and was kept. The
direction and distance questions mark the reference object in red and the others in blue, green, yellow or purple,
each in one fixed colour. The executor takes the bounding box of the largest connected outline of each colour and
answers from the boxes, the direction by the direction-relation matrix as for OSR and the distance between box
centres. On the validation split these rules agree with the reference answer on all 200 questions, as do the centre
angle and the distance between box edges. The configuration was fixed on the validation split before the test split
was evaluated. Three regional and 19 conditional counting questions fell back to the zero-shot answer. With
InternVL3.5-8B the same frozen configuration runs with that model as the VLM, set up as in
Section S6.7 , and 2 global, 10 regional and 58 conditional counting questions fall back to its
zero-shot answer. For 44 of the 58 the place or anchor that the question names is not found or is grounded with an
empty box; the other 14 have programs that are not well typed, as with Qwen3-VL-8B.

To measure what subdivision adds, we take the recorded answer of Qwen3-VL-8B
on the first, unsplit view of every counted region in the test run, the view a count without subdivision would use. Abstained questions keep the zero-shot answer, and the eight global counting questions whose image
is cut into cells keep their full count, which slightly understates the effect. On global counting the full system
scores 40.49, the unsplit view alone 24.87 and zero-shot answering 23.71, so subdivision adds 15.6 points
[11.7, 19.6], while counting the whole image in one view adds 1.2 [ − 1.4 -1.4 , 3.8] over zero-shot answering. On regional
counting the three score 49.34, 42.43 and 13.13. Restricting the count to the given box adds 29.3 points [26.3, 32.4]
and subdivision 6.9 [4.6, 9.2].

of the development split. All runs use one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 with 24 GiB from a fresh start, and times exclude model loading. Every VLM call
records its answer when it returns. Within a question, the time between consecutive records is charged to the later
call, and the time after the last call to execution. Visual tokens count one token per 32 × 32 32\times 32 pixels of every
image the VLM receives. Synthesis was timed separately with Qwen3-4B from a fresh start, one question at a time and in
batches of 16, the batch size of our runs.

blocks.en:
Nearly all of the time goes to VLM calls. Grounding is the expensive kind, at 3.6 to 9 s per call, because the VLM
generates a list of boxes, while a count costs about 0.45 s. An OSR question spends 24.3 s on 6.7 grounding calls on
average, and a counting question 12.6 s on 1.4 grounding calls and 7.3 s on 16.4 counts. RC needs no grounding,
since the red circle is found by its colour, and its crop is counted 2.9 times on average. Executing a program takes
less than 10 ms. Counting has a long tail, with a median of 6.7 s and a maximum of 185 s for a region that needs
deep subdivision. Peak GPU memory is 19.3 GiB for perception and 14.5 GiB for synthesis.

a question issued concurrently: the parts of a split view, the cells of a long window and the zoom windows of a

blocks.en:
The reproduced methods were timed on the test questions, on the same GPU model, from their per-question records.
WeaveEarth scores tiles with SigLIP2 and calls its VLM once per question, in 5.6 to 6.9 s. GazeEarth makes two calls
per counting question, with 5,435 visual tokens and 329 generated tokens on average, in 16.0 s. ZoomSearch scores
20.1 to 24.0 views per question with the confidence of its VLM, and RAP 30.9 layouts with Qwen3-VL-8B and 379.8 with
LLaVA-OneVision-7B, whose setting allows 200 steps. For reference, WeaveEarth reports
7.59 s per sample for itself on an NVIDIA A100, averaged over the two benchmarks it evaluates, and ZoomSearch reports 60.02 s per MME-RealWorld remote sensing sample
without naming the GPU, against 62.1 s in our runs.

blocks.en: Appendix S8 Failure analysis and examples
blocks.zh: 附录S8 失败分析和实例

blocks.en:
Hand-written programs change at most two of thirty answers per task (Section S3.4 ), so we look
at what perception gets wrong on the test split. Of the 209 OSR questions answered wrongly by an executed program, the computed direction lies
more than 45 degrees from the correct option in 179, and is roughly opposite to it in 48. With both referents grounded
on the right objects, the computed direction would lie near the correct option, so errors this large mean that a
referent was grounded on a different object, or that the annotation disagrees with the geometry. Only 30 wrong
directions lie within 45 degrees of the correct option, near the boundary between two options. Of the 605 counting
questions answered wrongly with a numeric answer, 243 are off by one or two objects and 249 by more than five. The count is
too low in 315 and too high in 290.
blocks.zh:
手写程序在每个任务中最多改变两个答案(S3.4节),所以我们看
测试分出什么感觉会出错 209个OSR问题被一个被执行的程序错误地回答,其中计算的方向是
与179年的正确选项相去超过45度,与48年的正确选项大致相反. 两名裁判都被禁足
在正确的对象上,计算出的方向会靠近正确的选项,所以这个大错误意味着
引文基于不同的对象,或注释与几何不同。 只差三十个
方向位于正确选项的45度以内,靠近两个选项之间的边界. 在605个统计中
243个被一个或两个对象关闭,249个被超过5个对象关闭。 计数是
315年太低,290年太高.

blocks.en:
XLRS-Bench overall counting asks for all instances of a class in the image, mostly ships, cars and boats, which make
up 38 of the 48 test questions. The true counts have a median of 61.5 and reach 734. Adjacent options differ by a
median of 17% of the smaller one, so a count must lie within about 8% of the truth to select the correct option.
GeoScope cuts the image into cells of at most 2,000 pixels and counts each with count-triggered subdivision. Its
counts are nearly unbiased, with a median signed error of − 0.9 -0.9 %, 25 too low and 21 too high. Their median absolute
error is 17.7%, however, and only 9 of the 48 lie within 8% of the truth. Table S37 compares the
methods we ran. GeoScope gains 25.0 points over its zero-shot backbone and is 2.1 points below both ZoomSearch and
always choosing the second-largest number, with intervals of about 20 points either way.
blocks.zh:
XLRS-Bench 总体计数需要图像中所有类别的情况,大多数是船舶、汽车和船只,它们使得
提高48个测试题中的38个 真实计数的中位数为61.5,达到734. 相邻选项因
中位数为更小部分的17%,所以一个计数必须位于真数的8%左右以选择正确的选项.
GeoScope 将图像切入到最多2000像素的单元格中,并用倒计时子分区来计算每个图像. 内容
计算几乎不带偏见,中值签名错误为-0.9-0.9%,25个太低,21个太高。 他们的中位数绝对值
然而,误差为17.7%,48人中只有9人位于8%的真相之内。 表S37 比较
我们逃跑的方法 GeoScope在零射入主干线上得分25.0分,比ZoomSearch和ZoomSearch低2.1分。
总是选择第二大数字, 间隔大约20个点, 无论是哪种方式。

blocks.en:
Table S38 shows two executions on MME-RealWorld counting test questions, both with a program that
counts a class in one quarter of a 4,096-pixel DOTA image. In the first, the lower-left quarter, widened by 15% on
each side, is too large for one view at 2.5 M pixels, and the model answers 7. Since 7 exceeds the horizon, the view
is split into four parts at native resolution, whose counts of 0, 0, 4 and 5 are accepted and sum to the true 9. The
zero-shot model chose 3. In the second, the first view answers 10, and one part again exceeds the horizon. The leaves
sum to 11 ships where the annotation has 2, and option matching selects the largest option, 4, while the zero-shot model
answers correctly. The recorded answers do not show whether the extra ships are spurious answers or real ships that lie in the quarter
but outside the corner the question means. For one or two objects the correct number is never the largest offered
(Table S28 ), so such an overshoot always fails.

每边都太大了,一个视图用2.5M像素,模型解答 7. 由于7号超过地平线,观点
根据本地解析分为四部分,其中0、0、4和5的计数被接受,并等于真数9。 这个
选择的零发模式 3. 第一种观点回答10个问题,其中一部分再次超过视野。 叶子
总和11艘舰船的注解为2,选项匹配则选择最大选项为4,而零射出型号
答对了 记录的答案没有显示额外船只的答案是虚假的还是真实的船在季度
但是在角落外 问题就意味着 对于一个或两个对象,正确的数字永远不会是最大的
(表S28),所以这样的过度射击总是失败的.
